items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, only from you, only that I knew you worked with him.

ctx.x: And, do you know, I went home and I passed by the telephone and looked, and there was -- I forget now who it was, twas a big, anyhow. Now, how did they know that I wasn't with Duke? I didn't tell them. News gets around, it got around s in those days. Anything you did, anybody else in the music world -- musicians would know about it the next day.

And so, Harry Ross was a member of the Amsterdam. Every year, we used to give a dance at -- up by the Manhatten Casino on 55th Street or the New Star Casino or some big place. And he was considered to be one of the best violinists we had. Harry Ross, did you ever hear of him?
Yeah, only from you, only that I knew you worked with him.
